title: Set up your household
subtitle: Fill in what you know. You can skip any step and change everything later.
chooseTitle: How do you want to set up?
manualBody: A short form per step. No AI needed.
aiBody: Answer a few questions in your own words. Needs a model endpoint, key and model name.
demoBody: Fills the household with made-up data so you can look around.
summaryBody: Nothing is saved until you confirm here.
weekend: If payday falls on a weekend
name: Name
secret_in_draft: That looks like a PIN, password or full card number. It was not saved. Enter only the last 4 digits.
bad_timezone: That time zone is not valid.
demoConfirm: This adds made-up accounts, transactions and goals. Continue?
aiSetupBody: Enter an endpoint compatible with the OpenAI chat-completions format, its key and the model name. A connection test runs next.
aiTestFailed: The model did not answer. Check the endpoint, key and model, or fill the form yourself.
consentBody: Your answers in this interview are sent to the provider at {endpoint}, together with the names of accounts you already entered. Nothing is saved until you approve the summary.
notUnderstood: I could not use that answer. Try again in other words, or skip.
secretRefused: That looks like a PIN, password or full card number. It was not saved. Please enter only the last 4 digits.
aiUnavailable: The model stopped answering. Your draft is kept; continue in the form from the same point.
done: All topics are covered. Check the summary.
ai_unavailable: The model is not answering right now.
ai_consent_required: Agree to what is sent first.
